items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a short exact sequence of quasi-coherent sheaves on X, Ass(F_2) is contained in Ass(F_1) cup Ass(F_3) and Ass(F_1) is contained in Ass(F_2) (source lines 130-140). The proof is the stalk reduction: at every point the sequence of stalks is a short exact sequence of modules over the local ring, so the corresponding algebra statement for associated primes yields both inclusions pointwise, which is exactly the sheaf statement.
